WITH monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', try_strptime(recvday, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS recv_month,
        COUNT(*) AS case_count
    FROM cases
    GROUP BY homefirm, recv_month
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
        c.headct,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    JOIN monthly_volume AS mv
        ON mv.homefirm = c.homefirm
       AND mv.recv_month = date_trunc(
           'month', try_strptime(c.recvday, '%Y/%m/%d')
       )
    WHERE c.soccd LIKE '13%'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        ca.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours + r.position_hours * ca.headct AS review_hours,
        (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS specificity
    FROM case_attributes AS ca
    JOIN review_schedule AS r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        review_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM matched_rules
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_hours), 2) AS average_case_review_hours
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1;

WITH site_scores AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS p
        ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.soccd LIKE '13%'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'

          = json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
),
case_scores AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        AVG(offered / NULLIF(prevailing, 0) * 100) AS score
    FROM site_scores
    WHERE offered IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY filekey
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_case_wage_assurance_score
FROM case_scores;

```sql
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) FILTER (WHERE CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) = 'Yes')
    / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) = 'Yes'),
    2
  ) AS avg_crh_yes,
  ROUND(
    SUM(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) FILTER (WHERE CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) = 'No')
    / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) = 'No'),
    2
  ) AS avg_crh_no
FROM main.cases c
JOIN (
  WITH ca AS (
    SELECT
      c2.filekey,
      CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
      pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
      CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
      substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
      cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
      CASE
        WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
        WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
        WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
        ELSE '15+'
      END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM main.cases c2
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
    JOIN (
      SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
        COUNT(*) AS emcv
      FROM main.cases
      GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) v
      ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  )
  SELECT
    ca.filekey,
    ca.monthly_volume_band,
    r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
    COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca
  LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY ca.filekey
    ORDER BY
      (
        CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ) DESC,
      r.rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
) g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01';
```

```sql
WITH december_cases AS (
    SELECT filekey, homefirm
    FROM cases
    WHERE try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
eligible_employers AS (
    SELECT homefirm
    FROM december_cases
    GROUP BY homefirm
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
case_worksite_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        dc.homefirm,
        dc.filekey,
        (
            TRY_CAST(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                    '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
                ) AS DOUBLE
            )
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1.0
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080.0
              END
        ) / NULLIF(
            TRY_CAST(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                    '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
                ) AS DOUBLE
            )
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1.0
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080.0
              END,
            0
        ) AS ratio
    FROM december_cases dc
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = dc.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
case_scores AS (

    GROUP BY homefirm, filekey
```

The schema does not define Wage Assurance Tier names or thresholds. Using a transparent interpretation—average offered wage as a percentage of prevailing wage, with scores of at least 100 classified as **Above Prevailing Wage**—Google LLC’s June 2024 score is **118.78**.

```sql
WITH june_wages AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REGEXP_EXTRACT(
                    p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from',
                    '[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?'
                ),
                ',',
                ''
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered_wage,
        TRY_CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REGEXP_EXTRACT(
                    p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',
                    '[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?'
                ),
                ',',
                ''
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing_wage
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS p
        ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Google LLC'
      AND STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-06-01'
      AND STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') <  DATE '2024-07-01'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT AVG(offered_wage / prevailing_wage * 100) AS score
    FROM june_wages
    WHERE offered_wage IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing_wage > 0
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN score >= 100 THEN 'Above Prevailing Wage'
        ELSE 'At or Below Prevailing Wage'
    END AS tier_name,
    ROUND(score, 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM scored;
```

Interpreting the Case Wage Assurance Score as offered minimum wage ÷ prevailing wage × 100, averaged across worksites per case and then across cases, the averages are **110.50** for H-1B-dependent cases and **121.64** for non-dependent cases.

```sql
WITH site_scores AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.h1bdep,
        100.0 * (
            try_cast(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                    '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
                ) AS DOUBLE
            )
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080.0
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                ELSE 1.0
              END
        ) / NULLIF(
            try_cast(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                    '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
                ) AS DOUBLE
            )
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080.0
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                ELSE 1.0
              END,
            0
        ) AS score
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-02-01'
      AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
case_scores AS (
    SELECT filekey, h1bdep, AVG(score) AS score
    FROM site_scores
    GROUP BY filekey, h1bdep
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM case_scores;
```

```sql
WITH jan_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        r.return_channel,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        c.seg_category,
        qa.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    LEFT JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        j.casenum,
        j.unit_value,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        CAST(rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.item_category IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER) AS specificity
    FROM jan_returns j
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = j.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = j.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = j.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = j.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = j.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR j.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR j.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
selected_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidates
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(flat_charge + unit_value * charge_pct / 100.0, 0)),
    2
) AS total_rhc
FROM selected_rules
WHERE rn = 1;
```

),
```sql
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
```

```sql
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw
```
  FROM main.cases c
```sql
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
employer_scores AS (
  SELECT
    homefirm,
    SUM(
      (
        0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
        + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
          END
      ) * headct
    ) / SUM(headct) AS ewas
  FROM case_wages
  WHERE date_trunc('month', start_date) = TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY homefirm
),
employer_tiers AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN ewas >= 60 THEN 'Exemplary' ELSE 'Other' END AS tier
  FROM employer_scores
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tier = 'Exemplary') / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM employer_tiers;
```

```sql
WITH monthly_returns AS (
  SELECT
```
```sql
    p.unit_value::DOUBLE AS v,
    json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.shipping.fee')::DOUBLE AS shipping_fee,

  JOIN products p

    ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
  WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00028'
    AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-01'
),

    v - (
      v * aesthetic_score / 10.0 *
      CASE completeness
        WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
        WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
        WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
      END
    ) + shipping_fee AS rvl
  FROM monthly_returns
)

FROM leakage;
```

```sql
        c.seg_category,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        qa.assessment_summary,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, SUBSTRING(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS cmrc
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    JOIN customers AS c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN products AS p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment AS qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.seg_category,
        b.unit_value,
        r.rule_id,
        r.flat_charge,
        r.charge_pct,
        (
            CASE WHEN r.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                       OR r.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM return_base AS b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules AS r
      ON (r.customer_segment IS NULL OR r.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (r.return_channel IS NULL OR r.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (r.item_category IS NULL OR r.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (
            r.primary_reason IS NULL
            OR r.primary_reason = json_extract_string(
                b.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason'
            )
         )
     AND (
            r.item_condition IS NULL
            OR r.item_condition = json_extract_string(
                b.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition'
            )
         )
     AND (r.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR r.min_monthly_returns <= b.cmrc)
     AND (r.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR r.max_monthly_returns >= b.cmrc)
    WHERE SUBSTRING(b.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM matched_rules
)
SELECT
    seg_category,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL
                 THEN 15.00 + 5.0 / 100.0 * unit_value
                 ELSE flat_charge + charge_pct / 100.0 * unit_value
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_rhc
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

“Customer Leakage Ratio” isn’t defined in the schema, so I treated it as February return cases divided by the customer’s total order count. The order dates are blank in this database, so the denominator cannot be restricted to February. Under that definition, the five highest ratios are tied at 1.00:

```sql
WITH feb_returns AS (
    SELECT o.buyerlink AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS feb_return_count
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    WHERE TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-02-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01'
    GROUP BY o.buyerlink
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT buyerlink AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY buyerlink
),
clr AS (
    SELECT
        f.customer_id,
        f.feb_return_count::DOUBLE / NULLIF(o.order_count, 0) AS clr
    FROM feb_returns f
    JOIN order_counts o USING (customer_id)
    WHERE f.feb_return_count >= 3
)
SELECT customer_id, ROUND(clr, 2) AS clr
FROM clr
ORDER BY clr DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
```
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
```sql
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
        COALESCE(om.replcost, 0) AS replcost,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', pr.snapts),
                         COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted')
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p
        ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm
        ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a
        ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om
        ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshot_base
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        CAST(r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(r.cap_band IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER) AS specificity
    FROM tiered s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM matching_rules
),
settlements AS (
    SELECT
        s.replcost,
        CASE WHEN r.rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 ELSE r.fixed_fee_usd END AS fixed_fee_usd,
        CASE WHEN r.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.00 ELSE r.cover_pct END AS cover_pct
    FROM tiered s
    LEFT JOIN ranked_rules r
        ON r.snapkey = s.snapkey
       AND r.rn = 1
    WHERE s.maker_group = 'Canadian Solar'
      AND s.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
      AND s.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(fixed_fee_usd + cover_pct / 100.0 * replcost),
    2
) AS settlement_usd
FROM settlements;
```

```sql
WITH return_leakage AS (
    SELECT
        c.seg_category,
        p.unit_value::DOUBLE AS unit_value,
        p.unit_value::DOUBLE
            - (
                p.unit_value::DOUBLE
                * TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.results.aesthetic_score') AS DOUBLE)
                / 10.0
                * CASE json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.completeness')
                    WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
                    WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
                    WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
                  END
              )
            + TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.shipping.fee') AS DOUBLE) AS rvl
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o
        ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p
        ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN quality_assessment q
        ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE substr(r.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'

)
```

```sql
        END AS cap_band,
```

```sql
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                         date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
        ) AS claim_volume,
        COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
```
```sql
    FROM main.plant_record r
```
```sql
    JOIN main.plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
target_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        *,

            WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'

            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM monthly_snapshots
    WHERE makertag = 'JA Solar'
      AND snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
),
ranked_matches AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        w.rule_id,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                w.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM target_snapshots t
    JOIN main.plant_record r ON r.snapkey = t.snapkey
    JOIN main.plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie

),
```

```sql
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY snap_month, maker_group) AS monthly_volume
    FROM snapshot_base
),
snapshots AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE
               WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
               WHEN monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Moderate'
               WHEN monthly_volume >= 4 THEN 'Bulk'

    FROM snapshot_volumes

                + (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
```

```sql
WITH snap AS (
```
```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        r.snapkey,
        r.snapts,
        COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
        m.makertag,
        m.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                         date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
        ) AS claim_volume,
        COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM plant_record r
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        w.rule_id,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.snapkey
            ORDER BY (
                (w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (w.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (w.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                + (w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
            ) DESC,
            w.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
settled AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        t.snapts,
        t.vol_tier,
        COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
          + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0 * t.replcost AS settlement_usd
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN ranked r
      ON r.snapkey = t.snapkey
     AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settled
WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE vol_tier
    WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Single' THEN 2
END;
```

Using efficiency loss as the Energy Loss Band basis, technology-months with an energy-weighted efficiency loss of at least 5% contribute **26.40%** of total recoverable energy.

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        m.pnlkind AS technology,
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
        try_cast(json_extract_string(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
        try_cast(json_extract_string(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.eff_loss_pct'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS eff_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record AS r
    JOIN plants AS p
        ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS m
        ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance AS e
        ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
),
tech_month AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        snapshot_month,
        SUM(energy_kwh * eff_loss_pct / 100.0) AS recoverable_energy_kwh,
        SUM(energy_kwh * eff_loss_pct)
            / NULLIF(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS energy_loss_pct
    FROM base
    WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
      AND eff_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY technology, snapshot_month
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE WHEN energy_loss_pct >= 5.0
             THEN recoverable_energy_kwh ELSE 0 END
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_energy_kwh), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM tech_month;
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_values AS (
```

answer:
Using **Recoverable Energy Loss = energy yield × soil-loss percentage**, I classified each technology-month by its average loss per snapshot: Low < 50 kWh, Moderate 50–<100, High 100–<150, and Severe ≥ 150 kWh. Under those cutoffs, Severe months contain 11 snapshots averaging **174.23 kWh**; Low months contain 34 averaging **34.51 kWh**. The prompt doesn’t specify band cutoffs, so these are an explicit assumption.

```sql
WITH snapshot_losses AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        m.pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS snap_month,
        TRY_CAST(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh'
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * TRY_CAST(
            e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct'
            AS DOUBLE
        ) / 100.0 AS loss_kwh
    FROM plant_record r
    JOIN plants p
        ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN panel_models m
        ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    JOIN electrical_performance e
        ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
tech_month AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        AVG(loss_kwh) AS avg_loss_kwh
    FROM snapshot_losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_loss_kwh < 50  THEN 'Low'
            WHEN avg_loss_kwh < 100 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN avg_loss_kwh < 150 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM tech_month
),
tagged_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        s.loss_kwh,
        c.loss_band
    FROM snapshot_losses s
    JOIN classified c
      ON s.pnlkind = c.pnlkind
     AND s.snap_month = c.snap_month
)
SELECT
    loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM tagged_snapshots
WHERE loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY loss_band
ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 END;
```

```sql
            THEN energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0))
        END AS potential_kwh
    FROM snapshot_values
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', snapts) AS month,
        100.0 * SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh)
            / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS loss_ratio
    FROM losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, date_trunc('month', snapts)
),
classified AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_ratio IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN loss_ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN loss_ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
            ELSE 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM monthly
),
with_band AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        c.loss_band,
        l.potential_kwh - l.energy_kwh AS loss_kwh
    FROM losses l
    JOIN classified c
      ON c.pnlkind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.pnlkind
     AND c.month = date_trunc('month', l.snapts)
)
SELECT
    loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM with_band
WHERE loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY loss_band
ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
```
